about: The realm builder (GitHub #13250): the bodies sent to POST /api/playtest/realms/plan, /pick and /realms (MAKE IT), and the board and the pick as ?as=lines answers them (SQL's verse.builder_lines). "lines" names every line. "steps" are calls as one player with the status and body the server answers today: "model" is what the planner's model answers from that step on (the API suite's fake), "wait" says the call comes at least two seconds after the last, and the plan's number, which each run decides, is written 41 here in bodies and answers. "message" names the answer: BoardLines and PickLines are the text; PlanReply, PickReply (builder.proto), MadeReply and MadeLines (made.proto), RouteError (record.proto) and ErrorWords (a refusal's words alone). metaverse-engine/editor/board.coax writes every body and reads every line; metaverse-engine/editor/board-goldens.coax holds them through it; coax/web/api/test_realm_builder.py makes the calls.

lines.says: the plan's number: what a revision and MAKE IT name
the realm's name, the rest of the line
a row of the board: its feature, whether it is on, its words
a thing asked for that the board has no row for
the picker's answer: the word picked, or none

steps.name: the page's first words come back as a board
steps.body: {"prompt":"a dark marsh with an old man by the bridge"}

style painterly
